descriptionChirho: Qal active sense: to put, place, or set something in a location or position; includes issuing or promulgating a decree (placing it into effect).
Qal sense with personal object: to appoint or constitute someone to a role or position, to make someone into something.
Nifal passive: to be put, be placed, be set, or be issued; the passive counterpart of the core Qal meaning.
Hitpael medio-passive: to be placed or be made, functioning as a reflexive-passive with emphasis on the process of being set or established.
